n_01a8eae2-0bad.name: Carlos Mujun
n_01a8eae2-0bad.text: You're a wonderful asset to UCG. Hope this week has been a step forward in healing. Always remember who Brittany was for you so she always stays with you.

n_06cd292a-29a7.name: Andre Holmes
n_06cd292a-29a7.text: So sorry. I'm at a loss for words but love you and both of yall for taking me in and giving me a place to stay and not letting the dog eat me.

n_0df2be00-75cf.name: Jackson
n_0df2be00-75cf.text: Anthony, I'm so sorry for your loss. Please know that I and your gymnastics family are here for you. Sending support to you and your loved ones.

n_0eea8b8a-eef1.name: Chris Whelen
n_0eea8b8a-eef1.text: Aloha Anthony. I'm so very sorry for your loss - I can't imagine how difficult it is for you. You are in my thoughts and prayers. If I can do anything to help you, please don't hesitate.

n_122f77b0-20cf.name: Kaelyn
n_122f77b0-20cf.text: Sending you the biggest hugs. I can’t imagine the loss you’re feeling. I hope that the memories you and Brittney shared provide some solace during this time and that you feel the love of your community around you. May her memory be a blessing 💜

n_19477037-09e6.name: Nick
n_19477037-09e6.text: I’m so sorry, Anthony. I can’t imagine what you’re going through right now. Brittney sounded like an amazing person, and I’m sorry I didn’t get the chance to know her. I’m here for you if you need anything.

n_39591e9f-b100.name: Kristin
n_39591e9f-b100.text: Anthony, I am so sorry for your loss and I know words cannot do anything to ease this time but please know our thoughts are with you and your family.

n_60e8f783-bab0.name: Jules
n_60e8f783-bab0.text: I'm really sorry to hear about Brittney's passing. You're an amazing human being, and I'm sure her influence on you was an incredibly positive impact on that. I'm so sorry that you have to go through this. You have an amazing community here that cares about you, so please don't hesitate to lean on us (myself included)!

n_65ab15ae-c0d1.name: Lucas
n_65ab15ae-c0d1.text: Anthony, I’m so sorry to hear about Brittney’s passing. It was clear that she was a light in your life and in the lives of those around her. I’m thinking of you and your family, and please know that the gymnastics community and I are here for you.

n_6e3ff0b7-9ab9.name: Mel
n_6e3ff0b7-9ab9.text: I am so sorry for your loss, Anthony. You are in our thoughts and we are here to support you in whatever way you need. Please don't hesitate to reach out if we can do anything.

n_7338fec1-3112.name: Nate
n_7338fec1-3112.text: I'm so sorry. Brittney was wonderful to speak with the few times we met, and I always got the sense from how you talked about her that we would have connected if we had the chance. I'm sad that I'll never get that opportunity. Please don't hesitate to reach out.

n_acf531fd-94ef.name: Tim
n_acf531fd-94ef.text: My heart hurts for you and for those who knew Brittney. We are all thinking about you and love you dearly. Sending hugs.

n_bc871c5b-5f6f.name: Lena
n_bc871c5b-5f6f.text:
Hi Anthony,
So sorry for your loss. My deepest condolences! 🙏 Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything at all! Your gymnastics family is here for you

n_bd008d43-44ba.name: Ethan
n_bd008d43-44ba.text: Anthony, I am incredibly sorry for your loss. We are all here for you, whenever you need, and however you need.

n_bd14b1a5-015a.name: Ilana
n_bd14b1a5-015a.text: I am so sorry for your loss. From the stories you shared, Brittney sounded full of life and adventure. Keeping you and your family in our thoughts.

n_f95eaa34-6a19.name: Julia
n_f95eaa34-6a19.text: I was so saddened to hear of Brittney's passing. While I only met her on a few occasions, I could tell from the way you spoke of her that your bond was special. If there's anything Nate and I or the gymnastics team can do, please don't hesitate to reach out.
